value.title: Your walk reveals the map
value.subtitle: The world starts under fog. Every step uncovers the ground you cross, and it stays yours for good.

points.walk: Only walking counts. Never driving or transit.
points.background: It keeps going with the app closed, on low power.
points.privacy: We never keep your route, only the zones you explored.

always.title: Explore without thinking about it
always.body: Allow "Always" location so Fogline keeps uncovering your map on your walks, even when the app is closed.
